visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A dark-haired woman wearing a navy trench coat stands on a subway platform. She is looking down, smiling, and meticulously applying red nail polish to her fingernails. Her hands are seen in a medium close-up, holding a small bottle and brush. Behind her, the empty tracks and platform tiles are visible under bright indoor lights. (2) Two women are outside on a bridge with the Eiffel Tower in the background. One woman has bangs and wears a beige trench coat; the other has long dark hair and wears a navy coat. They are smiling and looking into a selfie camera. The sky is bright blue and the scene is lit by natural daylight. (3) A woman's hands hold an old French transit pass close to the camera lens. The card features a small portrait photo of a younger woman. The background is a slightly blurred city street in Paris with historical stone buildings and a street lamp visible. (4) The woman in the beige coat is sitting on a low concrete wall in an urban square, holding her smartphone and taking photos. The Eiffel Tower looms large in the background across the street. Passing cars and pedestrians are visible in the mid-ground. (5) In a museum gallery, the camera zooms in on a famous oil painting titled "Impression, Sunrise" by Monet, which is housed in a golden frame on a grey wall. The gallery has polished wooden floors and clean, professional exhibition lighting. (6) Inside a spacious, industrial-style clothing boutique, a woman in a beige coat browses through racks of white and grey apparel. The shop features high ceilings, exposed metal beams, and a cafe area with wooden chairs and an American flag decoration.
